# rubric-builder

> Build versioned grading rubrics from human-scored examples: anchors per score level, a content fingerprint, semver bumps from rubric diffs and an exact judge prompt Python package `trysac-rubric-builder`, import name `rubric_builder`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
